summary: A sheet left at the public printer reaches someone who never opened the page it came from.
realLife: Librarians testified that patrons had left explicit images in shared printer trays where other people could find them.
inGame: needs: shared printer placement and an incident report.

turns.pulledBy: Staff find the sheet before pickup.
turns.what: A librarian clears the tray and records where it was found.
turns.writesBack: The board can distinguish a printer incident from a screen complaint.

turns.pulledBy: Another reader has already picked it up.
turns.writesBack: The board hears about an exposure away from the terminals.
